title: Three.js
summary: 3D shot like archive film of real objects: everything monochrome in silver, bone and navy with crimson as the only colour, soft light from above falling off into a dark table, and a hand-written film pass (grain, vignette, scratches, dust, lamp flicker, gate weave). The camera is always moving slowly.
usage: {"piece": "three/globe"}. Any of them also works full-frame as a "background". Files: library/themes/historical/three/pieces/ (shared plumbing in _film.js).

items.name: Desk globe
items.description: An old globe turning on its stand while a crimson route arcs across made-up continents and the camera pushes in.

items.name: Pocket watch
items.description: A pocket watch on a letter, its hands sweeping through the hours as the camera sinks toward it: time passing.

items.name: Open ledger
items.description: A ledger open on the table, its pages turning one after another under a crimson ribbon.

items.name: Film reels
items.description: Two film reels turning with the strip running between them past a lit gate. Loops.

items.name: Photo table
items.description: The documentary pan in 3D: prints and a letter scattered on a dark table, the camera drifting across them, a crimson thread between two pins.

items.name: Monument
items.description: A ruined colonnade around an obelisk in haze, seen on a slow arc, a crimson pennant at the top.

items.name: Dust in light
items.description: Dust motes drifting through a cold shaft of light in a dark room. A quiet full-frame background. Loops.
